Chicago Enterprise Zone V
Geographic Focus: West Side
Character: Core West Side coverage spanning Humboldt Park, Austin, Garfield Park, Hermosa, and Belmont Cragin. Targets neighborhoods with concentrated poverty and industrial vacancy.
Designated: 2016 | Expires: 2030 Primary Community Areas (6)
WEST GARFIELD PARK, HERMOSA, HUMBOLDT PARK, EAST GARFIELD PARK, BELMONT CRAGIN, AUSTIN All Community Areas (9)
Community Area Area # % Covered
WEST GARFIELD PARK #26 78.1%
HERMOSA #20 72.9%
HUMBOLDT PARK #23 52.1%
EAST GARFIELD PARK #27 38.4%
BELMONT CRAGIN #19 36.2%
AUSTIN #25 31.2%
LOGAN SQUARE #22 5.6%
AVONDALE #21 3.5%
ALBANY PARK #14 1.6% Benefits (All Zones Identical)
- Building Materials Sales Tax Exemption — Up to 9.25% (state + local). No investment threshold.
- Machinery & Equipment Exemption — 6.25% state sales tax. Requires $5M+ investment.
- Utility Tax Exemption — Gas, electric, telecom. Requires $5M+ investment.
- Investment Tax Credit — 0.5% on qualified property. 5-year carry forward.
- Contribution Deduction — Double deduction for approved EZ org contributions.
- Construction Jobs Credit — Credit for construction employment. How to Apply
Building Materials: Email application to ezadministrator@cityofchicago.org
